spans.s:
Lambana is the reading in the Kāṇva recension (v. 10, 1) of
the Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad for Āḍambara, ‘drum,’ in the
Mādhyaṃdina recension (v. 12, 1).

Lāmakāyana, ‘descendant of Lamaka,’ is often mentioned
as an authority in the Lāṭyāyana Śrauta Sūtra,^1 the Nidāna
Sūtra,^2 and the Drāhyāyaṇa Śrauta Sūtra;^3 also with the name
Saṃvargajit in the Vaṃśa Brāhmaṇa.^4
1) iv. 9, 22; vi. 9, 18, etc.; Weber,
Indische Studien, 1, 49.
2) iii. 12. 13; vii. 4, 8, etc.; Weber,
op. cit., 1, 45.
3) Weber, op. cit., 4, 384.
4) Indische Studien, 4, 373.
